Time Machine - VR Simulator

Desktop preview: drag to orbit, scroll to zoom.
In VR — point at the button and pull the trigger to power on.
Left stick: forward/back/strafe  •  Right stick Y: up/down  •  Either trigger: accelerate
Left X button: sit in the seat  •  Left Y button: stand back up
Grip squeeze: fire the gun  •  drones take 2 hits, the machine can take 3
